channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PT faz pesquisa e vai medir impacto de denúncia contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT will conduct an internal survey with Vox next week to measure the impact of allegations against Flávio Bolsonaro on the electoral landscape nationwide. The study will also assess whether Lula’s image improved following the end of the controversial 'shirt tax' issue.

item.title: Flávio ironiza ataque de Zema: ‘mineiro tem mais calma na hora de falar’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro mocked former governor Romeu Zema, calling him 'hasty' for criticizing his request for funding from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, saying miners usually speak more calmly. Flávio said he unsuccessfully tried to call Zema on Thursday and defended the conversation as a 'private investment', while Zema called it 'unforgivable'. The exchange sparked tension within the Novo party and raised doubts about potential alliances with the PL.

item.title: ‘Não tem que justificar nada’, diz Flávio sobre pedido de dinheiro a Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro said he does not need to justify requesting R$135 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about his father Jair Bolsonaro's life. He claimed the funds were private sponsorship and fully used for the movie, although part of the payment was routed through a U.S.-based fund managed by the lawyer of Eduardo Bolsonaro. The revelation threatens his presidential pre-candidacy, which had been polling ahead of Lula in several scenarios.

item.title: Crusoé: PF é cobrada por ‘vazamento seletivo’ de dados de Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy José Medeiros (PL-MT) filed an information request in the Chamber of Deputés demanding explanations from the Ministry of Justice regarding alleged selective leaking of confidential data related to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and the 'Master' case. The lawmaker questions the disclosure of audios, documents, and investigative elements that may constitute a breach of official secrecy.

item.title: Ala do PL do Rio vê Castro mais frágil, mas descarta abandono imediato
item.description: A faction of Rio de Janeiro's PL supports maintaining backing for former governor Cláudio Castro despite his ineligibility by the TSE and being a target of PF's Operation Sem Refino, arguing that wounded soldiers should not be abandoned. Another faction believes abandonment is inevitable but contingent on Flávio Bolsonaro's agreement, the PL's presidential pre-candidate. Altineu Cortês, Carlos Jordy, and Sóstenes Cavalcante are mentioned as potential replacements in the state race.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reforça equipe para responder a ‘situação de estresse’ após conversa com Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign is restructuring its communications team after leaked conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro revealed requests for funding to finance a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The move aims to strengthen crisis response and counter misinformation, with new hires led by Marcello Lopes and Victor Martins. The Intercept Brasil and Estadão confirmed the authenticity of messages discussing up to US$ 24 million in contributions, with payments already made through 2025.

item.title: Lula ironiza apoio do Master a filme sobre Bolsonaro: ‘Neste hospital não tem dinheiro do Vorcaro’
item.description: President Lula (PT) mocked financial support from Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro for a Bolsonaro-themed film, stating 'this hospital has no Vorcaro money'. During an event in Barretos (SP), he announced R$ 2.2 billion in health investments, including new funding tables for high-cost oncology drugs and robotic cancer surgeries in the public health system. Lula avoided naming Flávio Bolsonaro but indirectly referenced the alleged R$ 61 million contribution reported by The Intercept Brasil.

item.title: PF troca chefia de caso que envolve INSS e Lulinha; Mendonça e oposição cobram explicações
item.description: The Federal Police changed the leadership of the investigations in Operation Sem Desconto, which probes a fraud scheme involving the INSS and led to the lifting of secrecy on Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Lula. The change followed demands for explanations from the opposition and Senator Sergio Moro, who called for greater transparency in the probe.

item.title: Governo investe R$ 2,2 bi em tratamentos oncológicos no SUS
item.description: President Lula announced a R$ 2.2 billion investment to expand access to oncology treatments through the Unified Health System (SUS), including 23 high-cost drugs and robotic surgeries, benefiting 112,000 patients. The funding covers 18 cancer types, with ten drugs procured directly by the Ministry of Health and the rest distributed via Ambulatory Procedure Authorization, plus R$ 50 million for prostate robotic surgery and R$ 27.4 million annually for breast reconstruction.

item.title: Bolsonaristas veem Tarcísio distante e querem apoio maior a Flávio
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas drew criticism from Bolsonaro supporters for appearing distant amid the controversy involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. Bolsonaro-aligned activists in São Paulo expected stronger public backing for Flávio, viewing the situation as a test of loyalty to the movement.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio temem contágio e defendem Cláudio Castro fora da disputa ao Senado pelo Rio
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro in Rio's PL party are urging the immediate withdrawal of Cláudio Castro's Senate pre-candidacy following a Federal Police operation against him. They fear political contamination could harm Bolsonaro's presidential campaign and Douglas Ruas' bid for state governor.

item.title: Lula é aprovado por 58% e desaprovado por 36% no MA, diz pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel poll released on May 15, 2026 shows that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) has 58% approval and 36% disapproval in Maranhão, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points and a 95% confidence level. 52.2% of voters rate his administration as 'good' or 'excellent', while 28.2% classify it as 'bad' or 'terrible'. The survey interviewed 1,180 people between May 8 and 13, is registered with the TSE under BR-07192/2026, and cost R$75,000 funded by the pollster’s own resources.

item.title: Comissão aprova reconhecimento da Romaria de Todos os Santos como cultura nacional
item.description: The Constitution and Justice Committee of the Chamber of Deputies approved Bill 319/25, which recognizes the Romaria de Todos os Santos, held annually in Monte Santo (BA) since 1785, as a manifestation of national culture. The proposal, introduced by Deputy Lídice da Mata (PSB-BA), was recommended by rapporteur Deputy Bacelar (PL-BA), who emphasized its alignment with the constitutional directive to value intangible cultural heritage. The bill will now proceed to the Senate, pending possible plenary vote in the Chamber, and must be approved by both houses before presidential sanction.

item.title: Lisboa tem mais eleitores brasileiros do que 5.231 cidades do Brasil
item.description: Lisbon has become Brazil's largest overseas electoral college for the 2026 presidential election, with 68,979 eligible voters, surpassing the electorate of 5,231 Brazilian cities. A 52.4% increase since 2022 is straining voting infrastructure in Portugal, with 183 polling sections and 87 electronic ballots planned at the University of Lisbon, following long lines and a fraud-related detention in 2022.

item.title: A pergunta que a pesquisa Quaest levanta sobre teto eleitoral de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Lula's approval rose from 43% to 46%, while Flávio Bolsonaro holds 32% of voting intentions in the first round, with a technical tie of 42% to 41% in the second round. The Lula government is betting on measures like Desenrola, income tax exemption, and ending the 'blusinhas tax' to improve public economic perception. Despite positive macroeconomic indicators, the feeling of financial stagnation persists among voters, especially due to supermarket prices and indebtedness, while Flávio Bolsonaro appears to have hit a ceiling in his candidacy.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 55% e aprovado por 41% no AM, diz pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel survey conducted from May 8 to 14, 2026, in Amazonas reveals that 55% of voters disapprove of President Lula's government, compared to 41% who approve, with 44.3% rating the administration as 'bad' or 'terrible'. The poll, with a 3-percentage-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, is registered with the TSE under BR-03812/2026 and cost R$75,000.

item.title: Caiado diz que “vacina contra o PT é o resultado”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD pre-candidate for president, claimed his administration's results as former governor of Goiás act as a 'vaccine' against the PT, generating dissatisfaction with the party. He criticized the PT in a video posted on his social media, suggesting his state-level performance serves as an ideological antidote.

item.title: PL já estuda tirar Castro do palanque de Flávio Bolsonaro no RJ
item.description: A Federal Police launched an operation targeting former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL-RJ), weakening Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) support base as a pre-candidate for president. Castro, a close ally of Bolsonaro, had been chosen by him to run for one of two Senate seats in 2026. The police action directly undermines the state-level slate backing Bolsonaro’s presidential bid.

item.title: Crusoé: “Neste hospital não tem dinheiro do Vorcaro”, diz Lula
item.description: During a visit to the Hospital of Amor in Barretos, President Lula made disjointed remarks, stating he opposes the use of artificial intelligence in elections, calls for eradicating hatred, and then added that 'in this hospital here, there is no Vorcaro money'. The comments, made during an institutional visit, drew attention for their apparent lack of coherence.

item.title: Lula ironiza Flávio Bolsonaro e diz que 'aqui não tem dinheiro do Vorcaro'
item.description: President Lula mocked Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during an event in São Paulo, denying the existence of 'Vorcaro money' in his campaign and reiterating his support for banning the use of artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections. The statement was made in a critical tone toward allegations of illicit financing directed at the Workers' Party government.

item.title: Líder do PL diz esperar que Castro 'mostre sua inocência' após ser alvo de operação da PF no Rio
item.description: PL chamber leader Sóstenes Cavalcante defended former Rio governor Cláudio Castro, target of a PF operation, saying he expects Castro to present his defense and prove innocence. He also praised Flávio Bolsonaro, alleging the audio leak was a government attack, and noted internal party tensions with the Novo over alliances.

item.title: Indique um juiz antiativista, Lula
item.description: Lula struggles to appoint a new STF minister after Messias's rejection. Current options like Toffoli, Zanin, and Dino are seen as misguided due to their reliance on personal loyalty rather than technical merit. The piece advocates a third alternative: an anti-activist judge who emphasizes judicial restraint and respect for the separation of powers, benefiting both the STF and Brazil.

item.title: A disputa por governo e Senado no Amazonas, segundo pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll shows bolsonarist pre-candidate Maria do Carmo Seffair (PL) leading the race for Amazonas governor in all tested scenarios, with her advantage increasing when backed by Jair Bolsonaro. In the Senate race, Omar Aziz (PSD) is favored in simulations without Maria do Carmo, though the poll does not provide complete data for this contest. Key opponents include Roberto Cidade (União Brasil), David Almeida (Avante) and Isael Munduruku (Rede).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro critica ADPF que gerou operação contra Castro, mas evita falar do aliado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized the STF's ADPF 635, claiming it undermines public safety in Rio de Janeiro by restricting police operations and empowering criminals. His remarks came shortly after a search warrant was issued against his political ally, former Rio Governor Cláudio Castro, also linked to the same ADPF. Bolsonaro avoided answering questions about the operation against Castro, instead shifting focus to alleged interference by other branches in security matters and reiterating that funding for the film about his father was private.

item.title: O cargo de Daniel Vorcaro em filme sobre Bolsonaro, segundo IMDB
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, is listed as an executive producer of the film 'Dark Horse' on IMDb, a work inspired by the trajectory of former President Jair Bolsonaro. His involvement surfaced after an audio leak in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) demanded pending payments related to the project. The film's IMDb page can be edited by users with paid accounts on the platform.

item.title: Esse hospital não tem dinheiro de Vorcaro, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva referenced the case involving Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Vorcaro, stating 'this hospital does not have Vorcaro's money' during a visit to the Hospital do Amor in Barretos. Lula warned against disinformation and reiterated that the audio linking Flávio to Vorcaro is a 'police matter', not his responsibility, after the pre-candidate admitted negotiating US$24 million for the financing of the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Vorcaro aparece como produtor de filme sobre Bolsonaro no IMDb
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro is listed as an executive producer of the film 'Dark Horse', depicting Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 presidential campaign, on IMDb, although his credit was later removed. He allegedly made at least six transfers between February and May 2025 totaling R$ 61 million to finance the production, with intercepted communications revealing discussions with Flávio Bolsonaro about payment delays. The film features Jim Caviezel, directed by Cyrus Nowrasteh, and includes former Bolsonaro culture minister Mário Frias, amid allegations of public fund usage and financial controversies.

item.title: 'Aqui não tem dinheiro do Vorcaro': Lula ironiza elo entre Flávio Bolsonaro e dono do Master durante visita a hospital em SP
item.description: Lula mocked the alleged connection between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro during a visit to the Hospital of Love in Barretos, stating the institution received no funds from the businessman. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro admitted seeking private financial support from Vorcaro for a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro, after initially denying involvement. Vorcaro is detained in Operation Compliance Zero, investigated for financial fraud, corruption, and money laundering.

item.title: Após áudio de Flávio, Lindbergh pede que STF determine instalação da CPI do Master
item.description: Federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a request with the STF to immediately install the Master CPMI, citing an audio recording between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and Daniel Vorcaro as justification for the investigation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro nega encontro de Jair com Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro denied that Jair Bolsonaro ever met with Daniel Vorcaro, stating that the financing of the film 'Dark Horse' came solely from private funds and involved no irregularities. He clarified that Vorcaro’s final payment was made in May 2025 and that his brother Eduardo did not receive direct funds from the project. Flávio also reiterated that the fund manager is Eduardo’s lawyer and advocated for a CPI to investigate alleged fraud at Banco Master.

item.title: Lula aparece à frente de Flávio no 1º e 2º turnos no MA, diz pesquisa
item.description: Lula leads voting intentions in Maranhão in both the first and second rounds against Flávio Bolsonaro, with 56.4% and 61.6%, respectively, according to an AtlasIntel poll conducted May 8–13, 2026. The survey, registered with the TSE under BR-07192/2026, interviewed 1,180 voters with a 3-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Zanin envia pedido sobre eleição em Roraima para análise da presidência do STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin has ordered that the Republicans' petition to suspend direct elections in Roraima be redistributed for analysis by the Court's presidency, as he considers it a 'different act' from the Rio de Janeiro mandate-tampon case. The party requests that the president of Roraima's Legislative Assembly remain in office pending merit judgment, citing similarity to the Fluminense case, although the TSE ordered direct elections in Roraima — unlike in Rio, where an indirect vote was mandated. The final decision on case distribution will rest with STF President Edson Fachin, who will determine whether it is randomly assigned or allocated by prevention to a minister with expertise in similar matters.

item.title: Eleitores de três municípios elegem novos prefeitos e de outro vereadores neste domingo (17)
item.description: Voters in Brejo Alegre (SP), Itaú and Ouro Branco (RN) will go to the polls this Sunday (17) to elect new mayors and vice-mayors in supplementary elections, following the loss of office of officials elected in 2024. In Melgaço (PA), voters are renewing all 11 seats on the City Council due to the annulment of nearly 80% of valid votes from gender quota fraud and the cassation of mandates of councilors elected in 2024. Elected officials will serve until December 31, 2028, with voting from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Brasília time.

item.title: Moro sai em defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro e assina CPI do Master
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) defended Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) after audio leaks revealed the latter requested R$135 million from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to fund the film Dark Horse. Moro stated that Flávio has already explained the episode and that both have signed the CPMI request for a Master Bank investigation, arguing the opposition seeks a thorough probe while the PT exploits the case. Vorcaro disbursed R$61 million via a U.S.-based fund, and the film is already under STF scrutiny for suspected irregular parliamentary 'pix' amendments.

item.title: Aumento da mistura obrigatória do diesel não deve sair em 2026
item.description: The mandatory increase in biodiesel blend in diesel from B15 to B16 has been postponed to 2027, despite expectations of a 2026 announcement, due to required technical tests starting in May and lasting at least six months. The advancement depends on the National Energy Policy Council (CNPE), linked to the Ministry of Mines and Energy, and its approval was delayed after the cancellation of a May meeting. Although the government signaled intent to announce the change in 2026, officials from other sectors consider the timeline unlikely, while congressmen and the biofuels sector push for the measure to reduce fuel import dependence.

item.title: Tebet sobre Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Presidenciável íntimo de banqueiro envolvido no maior escândalo de corrupção do Brasil'
item.description: Simone Tebet criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential pre-candidacy, stating his close ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro — implicated in a major corruption scandal — make it untenable. She accused him of lying about negotiations to fund a film on Jair Bolsonaro and violating parliamentary decorum, calling for him to explain himself before the Ethics Committee.

item.title: Centrão repensa aliança com Flávio Bolsonaro após áudios que mostram proximidade com Vorcaro
item.description: The Centrão faction that had been moving toward an alliance with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) now urges caution following the release of audio clips in which the pre-candidate asks for money from former banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Master. The group has decided to delay any decision on forming a coalition around the opposition figure, citing concerns over potential associations with irregularities. The episode has triggered internal alarms about the political viability of the rapprochement.

item.title: Dino abre apuração sobre emendas a produtora de filme após áudio de Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino has ordered the opening of a separate investigation into parliamentary amendments by Bolsonarist deputies directed to the production company behind the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays the trajectory of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The move follows the release of an audio involving Dino that raised suspicions of potential irregular favoritism. The inquiry aims to determine whether public funds were misused or improperly allocated.

item.title: São Paulo acerta retorno de velho conhecido para comando técnico
item.description: Dorival Júnior is São Paulo's new head coach, returning for his third stint at the club after agreeing to a R$2 million annual salary through 2026. He replaces Roger Machado, who was sacked following the team's Copa do Brasil elimination, and arrives with São Paulo in the G4 of the Brasileirão and qualified for the Sudamericana knockout stage.

item.title: Médica ‘adoradora de Lula’, ‘marxistas drogados’, ‘pílulas mágicas’ de Damares: veja detalhes do roteiro de Dark Horse
item.description: The script of the film Dark Horse, sponsored by Daniel Vorcaro, features fictional scenes that associate political opponents of Jair Bolsonaro with negative stereotypes, such as a nurse described as a 'Lula worshiper' and the attacker, Adélio Bispo, portrayed under the fictional name Aurélio Barba as linked to 'drugged Marxists'. The film also references 'magic pills' tied to former minister Damares Alves. The content reflects a polarized narrative blending historical facts with conspiracy theories and dramatization.

item.title: Áudio: Lei institui Dia Nacional de Mobilização em Memória das Vítimas de Trânsito
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed Law 15.403/2026, establishing the National Mobilization Day in Memory of Traffic Victims, to be observed annually on the third Sunday of November. The law originated from Bill 382/2026 and was published in the Official Gazette on March 11, 2026.

item.title: Ao lado de Ruas, Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter pedido dinheiro a Vorcaro quando banqueiro era 'cortejado' por autoridades
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he sought financial help from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to fund the film 'Dark Horse' when the banker was widely 'courted' by authorities. The comment was made during the delivery of equipment to the Rio de Janeiro Military Police, alongside gubernatorial pre-candidate Douglas Ruas and other PL allies. Federal Police are investigating whether the funds were used to finance Eduardo Bolsonaro’s stay in the U.S., while protesters at the event questioned the 'Master money'.

item.title: Não faltam razões para Flávio Bolsonaro desidratar, mas suas redes sociais cresceram desde quarta
item.description: Despite the serious revelation regarding the close ties between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, bolsonarism did not immediately retreat from its core support — at least not yet. The article is exclusive to subscribers, restricting full access to the analysis. Social media growth since Wednesday indicates resilience within Bolsonaro’s base despite the scandal.

item.title: Vaivém retórico de Flávio Bolsonaro aprofunda dúvidas sobre destino do dinheiro de Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, faced backlash after admitting he received 61 million reais from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to fund the film Dark Horse about Jair Bolsonaro — despite initially denying any connection. He claims the money went to a U.S.-based fund managed by an attorney for Eduardo Bolsonaro, but provided no proof of the funds’ actual use, raising concerns about potential misuse, especially after Deputy Mário Frias and production company GOUP Entertainment denied Vorcaro’s involvement in the project.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Zema 'se precipitou' ao criticá-lo por áudio a Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema of acting hastily in criticizing him over messages in which he requested money from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio stated he does not need to justify seeking private investment for the film and claimed Zema was misled by rushing to speak first. He later confirmed receiving R$ 61 million from Vorcaro, initially denying the request and then asserting the funding was entirely private.

item.title: Documentário sobre Bolsonaro estreia com sessões vazias, exalta ex-presidente, ignora Michelle e omite derrota e tentativa de golpe
item.description: The documentary 'A Colisão dos Destinos', about Jair Bolsonaro, premiered to nearly empty theaters, praising the ex-president while omitting Michelle Bolsonaro, his electoral defeat, and the January 8 coup attempt. Produced by Mario Frias with input from Eduardo Bolsonaro, it promises a 'humanized version' but avoids key facts from his administration.

item.title: Contratos Master: Flávio deu explicações capengas; Alexandre de Moraes, nem isso
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro gave an interview on GloboNews attempting to explain his request for funds from Daniel Vorcaro, claiming it was for the production of the film 'Dark Horse' and that he was unaware of Vorcaro's criminal activities, though his explanation left many loose ends. In contrast, Minister Alexandre de Moraes has remained silent regarding his ties to Vorcaro through his wife, offering no public justification. Both figures are linked to contracts potentially worth around R$ 130 million, revealing a pattern of cross-political financing through the same financial intermediary.

item.title: Por Dentro das Eleições: saiba como funciona a aplicação dos recursos de campanha
item.description: The use of campaign resources in Brazil is governed by TSE Resolution No. 23.607/2019, which mandates the use of dedicated bank accounts, identification of resource origins, itemization of expenses, and annual and electoral financial reporting to ensure transparency and oversight by the Electoral Justice. Parties may use funds from the Party Fund, individual donations, or personal resources, provided they are previously registered and transferred to the 'Campaign Donations' account.

item.title: Tarcísio foi pego de surpresa por diálogos de Flávio com Vorcaro e questionou gestão de crise, dizem aliados
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas questioned the campaign's crisis management after learning that Flávio Bolsonaro negotiated with Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse' without his prior knowledge, causing a breach of trust. Sources indicate Tarcísio criticized the lack of preparedness to respond to the allegations and emphasized the need for ongoing clarifications from Flávio.

item.title: Operação da PF contra Castro deixa aliados em estado de alerta
item.description: The Federal Police launched an operation against former Rio governor Cláudio Castro (PL), putting his allies on alert in the state legislature. The move intensifies fears of further investigations targeting figures from Castro’s political circle, following arrests of Bacellar, TH Joias, and Thiago Rangel. The climate of distrust impacts Rio’s succession race and the legislature’s reputation, already under scrutiny by the Supreme Court.
